messages:
Yara: FYI console flagged a steady stream of 'project:unverified' for org-orion starting ~08:12. Billing sees drift. Can infra triage?
Tom: any sample req id or edge?
Yara: req id c7d2f1 (us-west-2). Upstream had header `x-claim-project:analytics-v2` but auth-exchange returned 200 with empty project claim. Router mapped to project:unverified.
Liam: that sounds like the exchange proxy unwrapping tokens and not stamping claims when it hits a wrapped-key edge case. We run into this when token has legacy claim format.
Sasha: product wants zero silent billing changes. Propose we implement a short-term soft-attribute path: preserve header-based project as `soft_attr` (keeps UI/rateband but visually flagged) and add telemetry fields so accounting can exclude soft from immediate billing.
Tom: telemetry proposal: add `claim_source=header|exchange|introspect`, `claim_confidence=high|soft|none`, and `claim_note` free text for debug. Also emit `audit_event=claim_soft_preserved` when we preserve a header.
Liam: agree. Router change behind feature flag: when exchange returns 200 but project claim is missing and header exists, set `claim_confidence=soft` and route using header bucket. Do not change backend rateband mapping until reconciliation confirms.
Yara: reconciliation plan: spawn lightweight worker `attr-claimer` that listens to auth-confirmation stream for 48h and if a later event proves the project, emit `billing_reassign` message {req_id, old=project:unverified, new=project:X, reconciled_at}. Accounting can then reconcile invoices or apply retro-charge.
Sasha: UX: console should show yellow "unverified" badge with hover: "Header attribution present but not verified by exchange. Click to request pin (requires admin + billing ack)." Also show a link to audit entry.
Tom: alerting: add rule when `claim_confidence=soft` > 0.5% of total traffic for any org over 10m and a separate alert for exchange 5xx > 0.2%/5m. ops-bot can create runbook link.
ops-bot: created tickets ENG-5001 (telemetry schema) and ENG-5002 (router flag + soft attr). Runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/exchange-soft-attr
audit-bot: audit events will include `audit_action:soft_preserve` and `actor:router` when header preserved.
Liam: owners: Tom (telemetry), Sasha (console UX + pin flow copy), Yara (RFC + reconciliation), me (router change). Timeline: telemetry + alerting today (few hours), router flag next week, attr-claimer prototype in 2w.
Yara: I'll file RFC and track ENG-5001/5002. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Sasha: will mock UI and post screenshots.
Tom: pushing schema PR now, will add log-parser update.
Liam: I'll start the router flag branch and coordinate with QA.
Yara: closing loop: keep thread open until at least telemetry + alert exist.
